%PLAYERNAME%! I’ve been looking into Mega Evolution, and three remarkable Pokémon have caught my attention—Chesnaught, Delphox, and Greninja.
And remarkable things deserve research! Each of these Pokémon brings something special to the table, so there’s no wrong choice here. Just three exciting paths of discovery!
An excellent choice! I had a feeling that would be your pick. Let’s take a closer look and see what this Mega Evolution can teach us.
Mega Chesnaught, eh? Both its armor and determination to defend are astounding. Now that's what I call a tough nut to crack!
Mega Delphox, eh? It dazzles its opponents with flaming branches before roasting them with a huge fireball. This research really heated up!
Mega Greninja, eh? It spins a giant shuriken fast enough to float, then clings upside down to catch opponents off guard. Talk about a surprise attack!
Check back during the Worlds 2026 Pokémon GO Finals for a special surprise!
